questions.question: A person sells a product at a profit of 15%. If he had bought it for 10% less and sold it for **₹**18 less, he would have gained 25%. Find the cost price of the product.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 15%

Reduced cost price = 10% less

Reduced selling price = ₹18 less

New profit = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Cost Price × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

Reduced Cost Price = Original Cost Price × (100 − Reduction%) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Cost Price = x

⇒ Selling Price = x × (100 + 15) ÷ 100

⇒ Selling Price = 1.15x

⇒ Reduced Cost Price = x × (100 − 10) ÷ 100

⇒ Reduced Cost Price = 0.9x

⇒ New Selling Price = 0.9x × (100 + 25) ÷ 100

⇒ New Selling Price = 1.125x

⇒ Reduced Selling Price = Original Selling Price − 18

⇒ 1.125x = 1.15x − 18

⇒ 1.15x − 1.125x = 18

⇒ 0.025x = 18

⇒ x = 18 ÷ 0.025

⇒ x = 720

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

questions.question: If sin A = 8/17 and cos B = 15/17,find sin A cos B+cosA sinB:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The expression **sin A cos B + cos A sin B** follows the compound angle identity **sin(A + B)**.

Given **sin A = 8/17** and **cos B = 15/17**, notice they belong to the **Pythagorean triplet (8, 15, 17)**.

This implies **cos A = 15/17** and **sin B = 8/17** as they share the same hypotenuse 17.

Substituting values: (8/17 × 15/17) + (15/17 × 8/17) = 120/289 + 120/289 = 240/289.

**∴ The correct answer is 240/289.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sin A = 8/17 and cos B = 15/17

**Formula Used:** sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B | cos²θ = 1 − sin²θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a77e3ac6804a1c525e559c9d03b1fa2fcd920ba9f6730e05ed2af298835384d4.png] 

⇒ First, find cos A: cos A = √(1 − sin² A) = √(1 − (8/17)²)

⇒ cos A = √(1 − 64/289) = √(225/289) = 15/17

⇒ Next, find sin B: sin B = √(1 − cos² B) = √(1 − (15/17)²)

⇒ sin B = √(1 − 225/289) = √(64/289) = 8/17

⇒ Required value = (8/17 × 15/17) + (15/17 × 8/17)

⇒ Value = 120/289 + 120/289 = 240/289

**∴ The correct answer is 240/289.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities for Sum/Difference

sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B and cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B.

Pythagorean Triplets

Sets of three positive integers a, b, and c such that a² + b² = c². Common examples include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17).

Range of Sine and Cosine

For any real angle θ, −1 ≤ sin θ ≤ 1 and −1 ≤ cos θ ≤ 1.</p

questions.question: A fruit basket contains apples and oranges. The number of apples is 25% more than the number of oranges. What is the ratio of apples to oranges?
questions.solution:

Apples are 25% more than oranges

Percentage increase = Original value × (100 + Increase%) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number of oranges = 100

⇒ Apples = 100 × (100 + 25) ÷ 100

⇒ Apples = 125

⇒ Ratio Apples : Oranges = 125 : 100

⇒ Ratio Apples : Oranges = 5 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 4.**

questions.question: A sum becomes 4 times its original value in 6 years under compound interest. In how many years will it become 16 times of the original amount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount becomes 4 times in 6 years

Required amount = 16 times

**Formula Used:**

A = P × (1 + r)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4P = P × (1 + r)⁶

⇒ (1 + r)⁶ = 4

⇒ 16P = P × (1 + r)t

⇒ (1 + r)t = 16

⇒ 16 = 4²

⇒ (1 + r)t = ((1 + r)⁶)²

⇒ (1 + r)t = (1 + r)¹²

⇒ t = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

questions.question: When a number is divided by 12, 15, and 20, it leaves remainders 5, 8, and 13 respectively. What is the least such number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Remainder when divided by 12 = 5

Remainder when divided by 15 = 8

Remainder when divided by 20 = 13

**Formula Used:**

If N leaves remainder r when divided by d, then N − r is divisible by d

Required number = LCM of divisors + common remainder

**Calculation:**

⇒ N − 5 divisible by 12

⇒ N − 8 divisible by 15

⇒ N − 13 divisible by 20

⇒ 12 − 5 = 7

⇒ 15 − 8 = 7

⇒ 20 − 13 = 7

⇒ N − 5 = N − 8 = N − 13 = common multiple − 7

⇒ Required number = LCM(12, 15, 20) − 7

⇒ LCM(12, 15, 20)

⇒ 12 = 2 × 2 × 3

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 20 = 2 × 2 × 5

⇒ LCM = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM = 60

⇒ Required number = 60 − 7

⇒ Required number = 53

**∴ The correct answer is 53.**

questions.question: If the average of 14 consecutive even numbers is 107, find the smallest number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 14 consecutive even numbers = 107

Number of terms = 14

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Number of observations)

Average of consecutive even numbers = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ Average = 107

⇒ (First term + Last term) ÷ 2 = 107

⇒ First term + Last term = 214

⇒ Last term = First term + 2 × (14 − 1)

⇒ Last term = First term + 26

⇒ First term + First term + 26 = 214

⇒ 2 × First term + 26 = 214

⇒ 2 × First term = 214 − 26

⇒ 2 × First term = 188

⇒ First term = 188 ÷ 2

⇒ First term = 94

**∴ The correct answer is 94.**

questions.question: A takes 12 days to finish a job, while B takes 36 days to complete the same job. If they collaborate, how many days will it take them to complete the work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A takes 12 days to complete the job.

B takes 36 days to complete the job.

**Formula Used:**

Work done in 1 day = 1 ÷ Time taken to complete the job.

Total work = 1 (entire job).

Time taken when working together = 1 ÷ (Work done by A in 1 day + Work done by B in 1 day).

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 1 ÷ 12 = 1/12.

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 1 ÷ 36 = 1/36.

⇒ Total work done in 1 day when A and B work together = 1/12 + 1/36.

⇒ Total work done in 1 day = (3 + 1) ÷ 36 = 4 ÷ 36 = 1/9.

⇒ Time taken when working together = 1 ÷ (1/9) = 9 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**

questions.question: The printed price of a TV set is 10,000. After two consecutive discounts, it is sold for 8,100. What is the second discount if the first one is 10%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Printed price of TV = 10,000

First discount = 10%

Final selling price = 8,100

**Formula Used:**

Price after first discount = Printed price × (1 - First discount ÷ 100)

Second discount = [(Price after first discount - Final selling price) ÷ Price after first discount] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Price after first discount = 10,000 × (1 - 10 ÷ 100)

⇒ Price after first discount = 10,000 × 0.9

⇒ Price after first discount = 9,000

⇒ Second discount = [(9,000 - 8,100) ÷ 9,000] × 100

⇒ Second discount = [900 ÷ 9,000] × 100

⇒ Second discount = 0.1 × 100

⇒ Second discount = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

questions.question: A sum of money becomes ​13/8 of itself in 5 years at a certain rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time = 5 years

Final amount = 13 ÷ 8 of principal

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = P × R × T ÷ 100

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Principal = P

⇒ Amount = 13P ÷ 8

⇒ Simple Interest = Amount − Principal

⇒ Simple Interest = 13P ÷ 8 − P

⇒ Simple Interest = 13P ÷ 8 − 8P ÷ 8

⇒ Simple Interest = 5P ÷ 8

⇒ P × R × 5 ÷ 100 = 5P ÷ 8

⇒ R × 5 ÷ 100 = 5 ÷ 8

⇒ R = 5 × 100 ÷ (8 × 5)

⇒ R = 100 ÷ 8

⇒ R = 12.5

**∴ The correct answer is 12.5%.**

questions.question: p + q = 12 and p ² - q ² = 72 then then what is the value of p-q?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **algebraic identity** for the difference of two squares: **p² − q² = (p + q)(p − q)**.

Substitute the given values into the formula: **72 = 12 × (p − q)**.

Divide the difference of squares by the sum: **p − q = 72 ÷ 12 = 6**.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sum of two variables: **p + q = 12**

The difference of their squares: **p² − q² = 72**

**Formula Used:**

The **Difference of Squares** identity is given by:

**a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)**

**Calculations:**

⇒ p² − q² = (p + q)(p − q)

⇒ 72 = 12 × (p − q)

⇒ p − q = 72 ÷ 12

⇒ p − q = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares Identity

The formula **a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)** is used to factorize the difference of two perfect squares.

Finding Individual Variables

Once **(p + q)** and **(p − q)** are known, you can find **p** by adding the equations and **q** by subtracting them.

Square of a Sum

Related identity: **(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²**, which represents the expansion of the square of a binomial.</p

questions.question: SA 90-liter mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 8: 7. if 15 liters of this mixture is taken out and replaced with 15 liters of pure milk, what is the new ratio of milk to water?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total mixture = 90 L

Milk : Water = 8 : 7

Mixture removed = 15 L

Pure milk added = 15 L

**Formula Used:**

Quantity of component = Total mixture × Ratio part ÷ Total ratio

Remaining quantity after removal = Initial quantity − Removed quantity

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total ratio = 8 + 7 = 15

⇒ Initial milk = 90 × 8 ÷ 15

⇒ Initial milk = 48

⇒ Initial water = 90 × 7 ÷ 15

⇒ Initial water = 42

⇒ Milk removed = 48 × 15 ÷ 90

⇒ Milk removed = 8

⇒ Water removed = 42 × 15 ÷ 90

⇒ Water removed = 7

⇒ Remaining milk = 48 − 8

⇒ Remaining milk = 40

⇒ Remaining water = 42 − 7

⇒ Remaining water = 35

⇒ New milk after adding pure milk = 40 + 15

⇒ New milk = 55

⇒ Water = 35

⇒ Ratio milk : water = 55 : 35

⇒ Ratio milk : water = 11 : 7

**∴ The correct answer is 11 : 7.**

questions.question: A spherical cannonball with a diameter of 28 cm is melted and recast into a rectangular block. The length and breadth of the block are 44 cm and 14 cm respectively. What is the height of the rectangular block?(Take pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of sphere = 28 cm

Radius of sphere = 28 ÷ 2 = 14 cm

Length of block = 44 cm

Breadth of block = 14 cm

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × π × r³

Volume of rectangular block = Length × Breadth × Height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × 22 ÷ 7 × 14³

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × 22 ÷ 7 × 2744

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × 22 × 392

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 × 8624 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume of sphere = 34496 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume of block = 44 × 14 × Height

⇒ Volume of block = 616 × Height

⇒ 616 × Height = 34496 ÷ 3

⇒ Height = 34496 ÷ (3 × 616)

⇒ Height = 34496 ÷ 1848

⇒ Height = 56 ÷ 3

⇒ Height = 18.67 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18.67 cm.**

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cylinder = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume of hemisphere = 2 ÷ 3 × 22 ÷ 7 × 9261

⇒ Volume of hemisphere = 2 ÷ 3 × 22 × 1323

⇒ Volume of hemisphere = 58212 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume of hemisphere = 19404

⇒ Volume of cylinder = 22 ÷ 7 × 3.5² × 9

⇒ Volume of cylinder = 22 ÷ 7 × 12.25 × 9

⇒ Volume of cylinder = 346.5

⇒ Number of bottles = 19404 ÷ 346.5

⇒ Number of bottles = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

questions.question: The diameter of a car's wheel is 63 cm. Calculate the distance the car travels when the wheel completes 1000 revolutions.
questions.solution:

Diameter of wheel = 63 cm

Number of revolutions = 1000

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of circle = π × Diameter

Distance travelled = Circumference × Number of revolutions

**Calculation:**

⇒ Circumference = 22 ÷ 7 × 63

⇒ Circumference = 198 cm

⇒ Distance = 198 × 1000

⇒ Distance = 198000 cm

⇒ Distance = 198000 ÷ 100

⇒ Distance = 1980 m / 100 = 1.98 km

questions.question: Find the equation of the line that passes through the point (2, 5) and is perpendicular to the line y = 3x + 4.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **slope** of the given line **y = 3x + 4** is **m₁ = 3**.

For a **perpendicular line**, the slope **m₂ = −1/m₁ = −1/3**.

Substitute the point **(2, 5)** into the equation **y = mx + c**: **5 = (−1/3)×2 + c**.

Solving for **c**: **c = 5 + 2/3 = 17/3**.

The required equation is **y = −x/3 + 17/3**.

**∴ The correct answer is y = -(x)/(3) + (17/3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation of the given line: **y = 3x + 4**

Coordinates of the point: **(x₁, y₁) = (2, 5)**

**Formula Used:**

Slope-intercept form: **y = mx + c**

Condition for **perpendicular lines**: **m₁ × m₂ = −1**

Point-slope form: **y − y₁ = m(x − x₁)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63c0f421b615d50dadfa9b055487714c2357821466d53387e2903d81f4de2593.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Comparing **y = 3x + 4** with **y = m₁x + c**, we get **m₁ = 3**.

⇒ Since the required line is **perpendicular** to the given line:

⇒ **m₂ = −1 / m₁**

⇒ **m₂ = −1 / 3**

⇒ Using the **point-slope form** for point **(2, 5)** and slope **−1/3**:

⇒ **y − 5 = (−1/3) × (x − 2)**

⇒ **3(y − 5) = −1(x − 2)**

⇒ **3y − 15 = −x + 2**

⇒ **3y = −x + 17**

⇒ **y = −x/3 + 17/3**

**∴ The correct answer is y = -(x)/(3) + (17/3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slope of Parallel Lines

If two lines are parallel, their slopes are equal (m₁ = m₂).

Slope Calculation from Coordinates

The slope m between two points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is given by m = (y₂ − y₁) ÷ (x₂ − x₁).

Standard Form of a Line

The standard form is Ax + By + C = 0, where the slope is −A/B.</p

questions.question: Find the value of 4x ² + y ² + 25z ² + 4xy - 10yz - 20zx when x = 4, y = 3 and z = 2
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x = 4

y = 3

z = 2

**Formula Used:**

a² + b² + c² + 2ab − 2bc − 2ca = (a + b − c)²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4x² + y² + 25z² + 4xy − 10yz − 20zx

⇒ (2x)² + y² + (5z)² + 2(2x)(y) − 2(y)(5z) − 2(2x)(5z)

⇒ (2x + y − 5z)²

⇒ (2×4 + 3 − 5×2)²

⇒ (8 + 3 − 10)²

⇒ 1²

⇒ 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

questions.question: Simplify:(sec(x) - tan(x))/(sec(x) + tan(x))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **sec(x)** and **tan(x)** into **sin(x)** and **cos(x)** forms mentally.

Since both **sec(x) = 1/cos(x)** and **tan(x) = sin(x)/cos(x)** share the same denominator **cos(x)**, it cancels out from both the numerator and denominator of the main fraction.

Resulting expression = (1 − sin(x)) / (1 + sin(x)).

**∴ The correct answer is ((1 − sin(x))) / ((1 + sin(x))).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (sec(x) − tan(x)) / (sec(x) + tan(x))

**Formula Used:** **sec(x) = 1/cos(x)** and **tan(x) = sin(x)/cos(x)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5065b3c6c413ddaf1256afe1dc77b3178231010e6258a17e0dfb7096ba73f58f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ [(1/cos(x)) − (sin(x)/cos(x))] / [(1/cos(x)) + (sin(x)/cos(x))]

⇒ [ (1 − sin(x)) / cos(x) ] / [ (1 + sin(x)) / cos(x) ]

⇒ [ (1 − sin(x)) / cos(x) ] × [ cos(x) / (1 + sin(x)) ]

⇒ (1 − sin(x)) / (1 + sin(x))

This expression matches the simplified form given in **Option 2**.

**∴ The correct answer is ((1 − sin(x))) / ((1 + sin(x))).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identity

One of the most used identities is **sec²(x) − tan²(x) = 1**, which implies **(sec(x) − tan(x)) = 1 / (sec(x) + tan(x))**.

Reciprocal Identities

**sec(x) = 1/cos(x)**, **cosec(x) = 1/sin(x)**, and **cot(x) = 1/tan(x) = cos(x)/sin(x)** are essential for simplifying rational trigonometric expressions.

Alternative Rationalization

Multiplying both numerator and denominator by **(sec(x) − tan(x))** transforms the expression into **(sec(x) − tan(x))²**, which can further be expanded or simplified based on the requirements.</p

questions.question: If sin 3A = 3/5 what is cos3A?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **Pythagorean triplet** for the given **sin** value.

Since sin 3A = 3/5 (Perpendicular/Hypotenuse), the sides of the triangle are **3, 4, 5**.

The **Base** of this right-angled triangle is 4.

Therefore, **cos 3A** = Base / Hypotenuse = 4/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 4/5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sin 3A = 3/5

**Formula Used:** sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfa89eae4acbb3c81d666cd922f41ba1474155fdc0d81f1210c1be6f390de95c.png] 

⇒ cos²(3A) = 1 − sin²(3A)

⇒ cos²(3A) = 1 − (3/5)²

⇒ cos²(3A) = 1 − 9/25

⇒ cos²(3A) = (25 − 9) / 25

⇒ cos²(3A) = 16/25

⇒ cos 3A = √(16/25)

⇒ cos 3A = 4/5

**∴ The correct answer is 4/5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

The fundamental identity sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 relates the sine and cosine of the same angle.

Triple Angle Formulas

For any angle A: sin 3A = 3sin A − 4sin³A and cos 3A = 4cos³A − 3cos A.

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets like (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17) satisfy the condition a² + b² = c² and are very useful in trigonometry.</p

questions.question: In a right triangle ABC, right-angled at B, if tan A = 2 what is the value of 2 sin A cos A?
questions.solution:

tan A = 2

sin A = Opposite side ÷ Hypotenuse

cos A = Adjacent side ÷ Hypotenuse

2 sin A cos A = 2 × sin A × cos A

**Calculation:**

⇒ tan A = 2 &
